verses.sloka: तैर्वध्यमाना देवाश्च ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः ।भयार्ताः शरणं जग्मुर्देवदेवं महेश्वरम् ।। ७.६.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tairvadhyamānā devāśca ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।bhayārtāḥ śaraṇaṁ jagmurdevadevaṁ maheśvaram ।। 7.6.1 ॥

translations.english: Tormented by them, the gods and the sages whose wealth was penance, distressed by fear, went to Maheśvara, the god of gods, for refuge.
translations.hindi: सुकेश को वरदान पाया हुआ तथा धार्मिक देख, विश्वावसु के समान तेजस्वी ग्रामणी नासक गन्धव ने

verses.sloka: जगत्सृष्ट्यन्तकर्तारमजमव्यक्तरूपिणम् ।आधारं सर्वलोकानामाराध्यं परमं गुरुम् ।। ७.६.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: jagatsṛṣṭyantakartāramajamavyaktarūpiṇam ।ādhāraṁ sarvalokānāmārādhyaṁ paramaṁ gurum ।। 7.6.2 ॥

translations.english: They went to him who is the creator and destroyer of the world, unborn, of unmanifest form, the support of all worlds, adorable, and the supreme teacher.
translations.hindi: अपनी देववती नाम की कन्या, जो दूसरी लक्ष्मी के समान थी तथा जो युबती और सुन्दरी होने के कारण तीनों लोकों में प्रसिद्ध थी

verses.sloka: ते समेत्य तु कामारिं त्रिपुरारिं त्रिलोचनम् ।ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवा भयगद्गदभाषिणः ।। ७.६.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: te sametya tu kāmāriṁ tripurāriṁ trilocanam ।ūcuḥ prāñjalayo devā bhayagadgadabhāṣiṇaḥ ।। 7.6.3 ॥

translations.english: Having approached Shiva, the enemy of Kama, the destroyer of Tripura, and the three-eyed one, the gods, with folded hands and voices choked by fear, spoke to him.
translations.hindi: तां सुकेशाय धर्सात्सा ददौ रक्षःश्रिय' यथा | वरदानकृतैश्वय सा त प्राप्य पतिं प्रिय ॥ ३ धर्मात्मा राक्षस सकेश को राक्तसलदमी की तरह दे दी । शिव जी से वरदान पाने के कारण सकेश ऐश्वयवान हो गया था । ऐसे प्यारे पति को पाकर

verses.sloka: सुकेशपुत्रैर्भगवन्पितामहवरोद्धतैः ।प्रजाध्यक्ष प्रजाः सर्वा बाध्यन्ते रिपुबाधनैः ।। ७.६.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukeśaputrairbhagavanpitāmahavaroddhataiḥ ।prajādhyakṣa prajāḥ sarvā bādhyante ripubādhanaiḥ ।। 7.6.4 ॥

translations.english: The gods addressed Shiva, saying, "O Lord, O Lord of creatures, all beings are being tormented by the sons of Sukesha, who are uplifted by the boon of Brahma and act as tormentors."
translations.hindi: देववती बैसे ही प्रसन्न हुई जैसे कोई निर्धन पुरुष घन पा कर प्रसन्न होता है । वह राक्षस सकेश भी उसके साथ बैसे ही सुशोभित हुआ

verses.sloka: शरण्यान्यशरण्यानि ह्याश्रमाणि कृतानि नः ।स्वर्गाच्च देवान्प्रच्याव्य स्वर्गे क्रीडन्ति देववत् ।। ७.६.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyānyaśaraṇyāni hyāśramāṇi kṛtāni naḥ ।svargācca devānpracyāvya svarge krīḍanti devavat ।। 7.6.5 ॥

translations.english: They have made our hermitages unsafe, and having driven the gods from heaven, they now play in heaven as if they were gods themselves.
translations.hindi: जेसे अंजन नामक दिग्गज से उत्पन्न हुआ महागज हथिनी के साथ स॒शोभित हो । हे राघत्र ! (तदनंतर समय पाके सुकेश) ने देववती के गभ से तीन अग्नियों के समान शरीरधारी तीन पुत्र उत्पन्न किए

verses.sloka: अहं विष्णुरहं रुद्रो ब्रह्माहं देवराडहम् ।अहं यमश्च वरुणश्चन्द्रो ऽहं रविरप्यहम् ।। ७.६.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ viṣṇurahaṁ rudro brahmāhaṁ devarāḍaham ।ahaṁ yamaśca varuṇaścandro 'haṁ ravirapyaham ।। 7.6.6 ॥

translations.english: They boast, "I am Vishnu, I am Rudra, I am Brahma, I am Indra, I am Yama, and Varuna, I am Chandra, and I am also Ravi."
translations.hindi: बलवानों में श्रेष्ठ उन तींनों के नाम थे--माल्यवान्‌ स॒माली अर माली । राद्दासराज सकेश ने तीननेत्रों के समान ये तीन पुत्र उत्पन्न किये थे

verses.sloka: इति माली सुमाली च माल्यवांश्चैव राक्षसाः ।बाधन्ते समरोद्धर्षा ये च तेषां पुरःसराः ।तन्नो देव भयार्तानामभयं दातुमर्हसि ।। ७.६.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: iti mālī sumālī ca mālyavāṁścaiva rākṣasāḥ ।bādhante samaroddharṣā ye ca teṣāṁ puraḥsarāḥ ।tanno deva bhayārtānāmabhayaṁ dātumarhasi ।। 7.6.7 ॥

translations.english: Thus, Mali, Sumali, and Malyavan, along with their battle-eager leaders, torment us; therefore, O god, you ought to grant protection to us who are afflicted by fear.
translations.hindi: सुकेश के ये तीनों पुत्र व्यग्रतारहित तीनों लोकों की तरह, गाह पत्यादि तीन अग्नियों की तरह अथवा तीनों वेदों की तरह अथवा वात पित्त कफ की तरह, उग्र और भयङ्कर थे

verses.sloka: अशिवं वपुरास्थाय जहि वै देवकण्टकान् ।। ७.६.८ ।।धन्ते समरोद्धर्षा ये च तेषां पुरःसराः ।इत्युक्तस्तु सुरैः सर्वैः कपर्दी नीललोहितः ।सुकेशं प्रति सापेक्षः प्राह देवगणान्प्रभुः ।। ७.६.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: aśivaṁ vapurāsthāya jahi vai devakaṇṭakān ।। 7.6.8 ।।dhante samaroddharṣā ye ca teṣāṁ puraḥsarāḥ ।ityuktastu suraiḥ sarvaiḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ ।sukeśaṁ prati sāpekṣaḥ prāha devagaṇānprabhuḥ ।। 7.6.9 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, assuming a terrible form, indeed destroy these thorns of the gods.
translations.hindi: सुकेश के तीनां अत्यन्त तेजवान पुत्र इस प्रकार बढ़ने लगे, जिस प्रकार उपेक्षा करने से रोग बढ़ता है

verses.sloka: अहं तान्न हनिष्यामि मयावध्या हि ते सुराः ।किं तु मन्त्रं प्रदास्यामि यो वै तान्निहनिष्यति ।। ७.६.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tānna haniṣyāmi mayāvadhyā hi te surāḥ ।kiṁ tu mantraṁ pradāsyāmi yo vai tānnihaniṣyati ।। 7.6.10 ॥

translations.english: After all the gods had thus spoken about those battle-eager leaders who torment them, Lord Shiva, with matted hair and blue-red form, concerned about Sukesha, spoke to the hosts of gods.

verses.sloka: एतमेव समुद्योगं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षयः ।गच्छध्वं शरणं विष्णुं हनिष्यति स तान्प्रभुः ।। ७.६.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: etameva samudyogaṁ puraskṛtya maharṣayaḥ ।gacchadhvaṁ śaraṇaṁ viṣṇuṁ haniṣyati sa tānprabhuḥ ।। 7.6.11 ॥

translations.english: Lord Shiva declared that he would not kill those powerful beings (Rakshasas) because they were invulnerable to him, but he would provide a strategy that would indeed destroy them.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु जयशब्देन प्रतिनन्द्य महेश्वरम् ।विष्णोः समीपमाजग्मुर्निशाचरभयार्दिताः ।। ७.६.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu jayaśabdena pratinandya maheśvaram ।viṣṇoḥ samīpamājagmurniśācarabhayārditāḥ ।। 7.6.12 ॥

translations.english: O great sages, taking this very plan as your guide, go seek refuge in Lord Vishnu, for that Lord will surely kill them.
translations.hindi: त्रयोमंत्रा--त्रयोवेदा | ( गो० ) २ त्रयश्रामयाः--वातपित्तश्ले-; ष्मरूपाः । (गो०) ३ त्रेताग्निसमबचेस इति तेजोतिशय उक्तः | (गो०) oe सत्यभाषण्‌, प्राणिमात्र में रुरल व्यवहार एवं समदृष्टि, इन्द्रियदसन आदि का नियम कर, उन तीनों ने ऐसा घोर तप किया, जो प्रथ्वीतल पर दुलेभ था । ऐसे घोर तप से वे देवतओं ओर मनुष्यों सहित तीनों लोकों को सन्तप्त करने लगे

verses.sloka: शङ्खचक्रधरं देवं प्रणम्य बहुमान्य च ।ऊचुः सम्भ्रान्तवद्वाक्यं सुकेशतनयान्प्रति ।। ७.६.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakradharaṁ devaṁ praṇamya bahumānya ca ।ūcuḥ sambhrāntavadvākyaṁ sukeśatanayānprati ।। 7.6.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, indeed, those afflicted by the fear of night-wanderers (Rakshasas) acclaimed Lord Shiva with cries of victory and approached Lord Vishnu.
translations.hindi: तब तो विभु, चतुमु ख एवं भूतभावन ब्रह्मा जी, विमान पर सवार होकर, वहाँ आए ओर सुकेश के धुत्रों को सम्बोधन कर बोले, हम वरदान देने को आए हैं (तुम वर सांगो)

verses.sloka: सुकेशतनयैर्देव त्रिभिस्त्रेताग्निसन्निभैः ।आक्रम्य वरदानेन स्थानान्यपहृतानि नः ।। ७.६.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukeśatanayairdeva tribhistretāgnisannibhaiḥ ।ākramya varadānena sthānānyapahṛtāni naḥ ।। 7.6.14 ॥

translations.english: Having bowed down and greatly honored the god bearing the conch and discus, they spoke agitatedly concerning the sons of Sukesha.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रादि देवताओं सहित ब्रह्मा जी को वरदान देने को उद्यत देख, वे सब राक्षस, वृक्षों की तरह थर थर काँपते हुए, हाथ जो ड़ कर, बोले

verses.sloka: लङ्का नाम पुरी दुर्गा त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिता ।तत्र स्थिताः प्रबाधन्ते सर्वान्नः क्षणदाचराः ।। ७.६.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: laṅkā nāma purī durgā trikūṭaśikhare sthitā ।tatra sthitāḥ prabādhante sarvānnaḥ kṣaṇadācarāḥ ।। 7.6.15 ॥

translations.english: O Lord, our abodes have been seized and taken away by the three sons of Sukesha, who resemble the three sacred fires, by virtue of a boon.
translations.hindi: हे देव ! तप द्वारा आराधन किए जाने पर, यदि आपह में चर देने को क तो हम माँगते हैं कि हमभें आपस में औति बनी रहे, कोई हम लोगों को जीत न पावे, अपने शत्र ओं का हम संहार किआ करें और हम अजर अमर हों

verses.sloka: स त्वमस्मद्धितार्थाय जहि तान्मधुसूदन ।शरणं त्वां वयं प्राप्ता गतिर्भव सुरेश्वर ।। ७.६.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvamasmaddhitārthāya jahi tānmadhusūdana ।śaraṇaṁ tvāṁ vayaṁ prāptā gatirbhava sureśvara ।। 7.6.16 ॥

translations.english: There is an impregnable city named Lanka, situated on the peak of Trikuta mountain, where night-roaming Rakshasas reside and torment all of us.
translations.hindi: MOR neh धत 0 0 440. 000 जी SS ¢ इस पर त्राह्मणबत्सल विभु ब्रह्मा जी बोले “तथास्तु”--तुम लोग ऐसे ही होगे । तदनन्तर सुकेश के पुत्रों'को यह वरदान दे, ब्रह्मा जी ब्रह्मलोक को चले गए

verses.sloka: चक्रकृत्तास्यकमलान्निवेदय यमाय वै ।भयेष्वभयदो ऽस्माकं नान्यो ऽस्ति भवता विना ।। ७.६.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakrakṛttāsyakamalānnivedaya yamāya vai ।bhayeṣvabhayado 'smākaṁ nānyo 'sti bhavatā vinā ।। 7.6.17 ॥

translations.english: O Madhusudana, for our welfare, you must destroy them; we have sought refuge in you, so be our protector, O Lord of gods.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! इस प्रकार वे राक्षस वरदान पा कर, अत्यन्त a निर्भीक हो, देवताओं ओर असुरों को सताने लगे

verses.sloka: राक्षसान्समरे दुष्टान्सानुबन्धान्मदोद्धतान् ।नुदं त्वं नो भयं देव नीहारमिव भास्करः ।। ७.६.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānsamare duṣṭānsānubandhānmadoddhatān ।nudaṁ tvaṁ no bhayaṁ deva nīhāramiva bhāskaraḥ ।। 7.6.18 ॥

translations.english: Offer to Yama those whose lotus-like faces are severed by your discus, for there is no other giver of fearlessness to us in times of fear except you.

verses.sloka: इत्येवं दैवतैरुक्तो देवदेवो जनार्दनः ।अभयं भयदो ऽरीणां दत्त्वा देवानुवाच ह ।। ७.६.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ daivatairukto devadevo janārdanaḥ ।abhayaṁ bhayado 'rīṇāṁ dattvā devānuvāca ha ।। 7.6.19 ॥

translations.english: O God, just as the sun dispels mist, you should dispel our fear by destroying these wicked, arrogant Rakshasas and their followers in battle.
translations.hindi: हे रघूत्तम ! उन राच्षासों ने हर्षित अन्तःकरण से, शिल्पियों में श्रेष्ठ, चिरंजीवी विश्वकमा के समीप जा कर कहा,

verses.sloka: सुकेशं राक्षसं जाने ईशानवरदर्पितम् ।तांश्चास्य तनयाञ्जाने येषां ज्येष्ठः स माल्यवान् ।। ७.६.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: sukeśaṁ rākṣasaṁ jāne īśānavaradarpitam ।tāṁścāsya tanayāñjāne yeṣāṁ jyeṣṭhaḥ sa mālyavān ।। 7.6.20 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the gods, Janardana, the God of gods, who grants fearlessness to his devotees and fear to his enemies, indeed spoke to the gods after granting them protection.

verses.sloka: तानहं समतिक्रान्तमर्यादान्राक्षसाधमान् ।निहनिष्यामि सङ्क्रुद्धः सुरा भवत विज्वराः ।। ७.६.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tānahaṁ samatikrāntamaryādānrākṣasādhamān ।nihaniṣyāmi saṅkruddhaḥ surā bhavata vijvarāḥ ।। 7.6.21 ॥

translations.english: I know the demon Sukesha, who is arrogant due to a boon from Shiva, and I also know his sons, among whom Malyavan is the eldest.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तास्ते सुराः सर्वे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ।यथावासं ययुर्हृष्टाः प्रशंसन्तो जनार्दनम् ।। ७.६.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktāste surāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ।yathāvāsaṁ yayurhṛṣṭāḥ praśaṁsanto janārdanam ।। 7.6.22 ॥

translations.english: I, being exceedingly angry, will kill those vile demons who have transgressed all limits; therefore, O gods, be free from fear.
translations.hindi: शिबभवन की तरह हमारा भवन बड़ा लंबा चोड़ा और ऊँचा होना चाहिए । उन महाबलवान्‌ राक्षसां के यह वचन सुन, विश्वकर्मा ने

verses.sloka: विबुधानां समुद्योगं माल्यवांस्तु निशाचरः ।श्रुत्वा तौ भ्रातरौ वीराविदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.६.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vibudhānāṁ samudyogaṁ mālyavāṁstu niśācaraḥ ।śrutvā tau bhrātarau vīrāvidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.6.23 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by the all-powerful Vishnu, all the gods, delighted, returned to their respective abodes, praising Janardana.
translations.hindi: उन लोगों के रहने के लिए इन्द्र की तरह स्थान बतलाते हुए कहा कि, दक्षिण समुद्र के तट पर, त्रिकूट नाम का एक पहाड़ है

verses.sloka: अमरा ऋषयश्चैव सङ्गम्य किल शकरम् ।अस्मद्वधं परीप्सन्त इदं वचनमब्रुवन् ।। ७.६.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: amarā ṛṣayaścaiva saṅgamya kila śakaram ।asmadvadhaṁ parīpsanta idaṁ vacanamabruvan ।। 7.6.24 ॥

translations.english: Malyavan, the demon, having heard of the gods' concerted effort, spoke these words to his two brave brothers.
translations.hindi: वहीं पर सुवेल नाम का एक दूसरा उत्तम पवत भी है । -उस पेत का बीच वाला शिखर बड़ा ऊँचा एक बड़े मेघ की तरह देख पड़ता हे

verses.sloka: सुकेशतनया देव वरदानबलोद्धताः ।बाधन्ते ऽस्मान्समुद्दृप्ता घोररूपाः पदे पदे ।। ७.६.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukeśatanayā deva varadānabaloddhatāḥ ।bādhante 'smānsamuddṛptā ghorarūpāḥ pade pade ।। 7.6.25 ॥

translations.english: It is said that the gods and sages, having met Shankara, spoke these words, desiring our destruction.
translations.hindi: उसके ऊपर उड़ कर पक्षी भी नहीं पहुँच सकते । क्योंकि चह चारों ओर से मानों टाँ कियो से छील कर, चिकनाया गया < हे | उसके ऊपर बनी हुई नगरी तीस योजन चौड़ी और सौ यांजन लबा हे

verses.sloka: राक्षसैरभिभूताः स्म न शक्ताः स्म प्रजापते ।स्वेषु सद्मसु संस्थातुं भयात्तेषां दुरात्मनाम् ।। ७.६.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasairabhibhūtāḥ sma na śaktāḥ sma prajāpate ।sveṣu sadmasu saṁsthātuṁ bhayātteṣāṁ durātmanām ।। 7.6.26 ॥

translations.english: O god, the sons of Sukesha, who are exceedingly arrogant due to the power of boons and possess terrible forms, harass us at every step.
translations.hindi: लङ्का के परकोटे की दीवार सोने की हैं और सोने तोरणा ( फाटका ) से भूषित हे । इस लङ्कापुरो को मैंने इ की आज्ञा से बनाया था

verses.sloka: तदस्माकं हितार्थाय जहि तांश्च त्रिलोचन ।राक्षसान्हुङ्कृतेनैव दह प्रदहतां वर ।। ७.६.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadasmākaṁ hitārthāya jahi tāṁśca trilocana ।rākṣasānhuṅkṛtenaiva daha pradahatāṁ vara ।। 7.6.27 ॥

translations.english: O Prajapati, we are overcome by these Rakshasas and are unable to remain in our own abodes due to fear of those wicked beings.
translations.hindi: मजबूत प्राकारों वाली और खाई से युक्त तथा सेकड़ों हजारों सुवणंभूषित गृहों से सुशोभित लङ्का में जा, वे सब राक्षस हर्षित हो रहने लगे

verses.sloka: इत्येवं त्रिदशैरुक्तो निशम्यान्धकसूदनः ।शिरः करं च धुन्वान इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.६.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ tridaśairukto niśamyāndhakasūdanaḥ ।śiraḥ karaṁ ca dhunvāna idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.6.28 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O three-eyed one, for our welfare, destroy those Rakshasas and burn them merely with a roar, O best among those who can burn.
translations.hindi: हे शत्र ओं का संहार करने वाले राक्षसा ! जब तुम बहुत से राक्षसों के साथ लङ्का में बस जाओगे, तब तुम शत्रुओं से दुधेषं हो जाओगे,

verses.sloka: अवध्या मम ते देवाः सुकेशतनया रणे ।मन्त्रं तु वः प्रदास्यामि यस्तान्वै निहनिष्यति ।। ७.६.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: avadhyā mama te devāḥ sukeśatanayā raṇe ।mantraṁ tu vaḥ pradāsyāmi yastānvai nihaniṣyati ।। 7.6.29 ॥

translations.english: Having thus been addressed by the gods and having heard their plea, the destroyer of Andhaka (Shiva), shaking his head and hand, spoke these words.

verses.sloka: यो ऽसौ चक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जनार्दनः ।हरिर्नारायणः श्रीमान् शरणं तं प्रपद्यथ ।। ७.६.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau cakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ ।harirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān śaraṇaṁ taṁ prapadyatha ।। 7.6.30 ॥

translations.english: O gods, those sons of Sukesha are not to be killed by me in battle; however, I shall give you a counsel (or a plan) that will indeed lead to their destruction.

verses.sloka: हरादवाप्य ते मन्त्रं कामारिमभिवाद्य च ।नारायणालयं प्राप्य तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् ।। ७.६.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: harādavāpya te mantraṁ kāmārimabhivādya ca ।nārāyaṇālayaṁ prāpya tasmai sarvaṁ nyavedayan ।। 7.6.31 ॥

translations.english: You should take refuge in that glorious Narayana, also known as Janardana and Hari, who holds the discus and mace in his hands and wears yellow garments.

verses.sloka: ततो नारायणेनोक्ता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः ।सुरारींस्तान्हनिष्यामि सुरा भवत विज्वराः ।। ७.६.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato nārāyaṇenoktā devā indrapurogamāḥ ।surārīṁstānhaniṣyāmi surā bhavata vijvarāḥ ।। 7.6.32 ॥

translations.english: Having obtained the mantra from Hara and saluted Shiva, they reached the abode of Narayana and submitted everything to him.

verses.sloka: देवानां भयभीतानां हरिणा राक्षसर्षभौ ।प्रतिज्ञातो वधो ऽस्माकं चिन्त्यतां यदिह क्षमम् ।। ७.६.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: devānāṁ bhayabhītānāṁ hariṇā rākṣasarṣabhau ।pratijñāto vadho 'smākaṁ cintyatāṁ yadiha kṣamam ।। 7.6.33 ॥

translations.english: Then Narayana addressed the gods, led by Indra, saying, "I will kill those enemies of the gods; O gods, become free from anxiety."

verses.sloka: हिरण्यकशिपोर्मृत्युरन्येषां च सुरद्विषाम् ।नमुचिः कालनेमिश्च संह्रादो वीरसत्तमः ।। ७.६.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipormṛtyuranyeṣāṁ ca suradviṣām ।namuciḥ kālanemiśca saṁhrādo vīrasattamaḥ ।। 7.6.34 ॥

translations.english: O best of Rakshasas, Hari has promised the destruction of us (Rakshasas) to the terrified gods; therefore, let us consider what is appropriate to do in this situation.
translations.hindi: उस महाभागा ने यह विवाह उत्तराफाल्गुनी नक्षत्र में किआ था । हे रास ! सुकेश के वे पुत्र, अपनी अपनी-अपनी पत्नियों साथ

verses.sloka: राधेयो बहुमायी च लोकपालो ऽथ धार्मिकः ।यमलार्जुनौ च हार्दिक्यः शुम्भश्चैव निशुम्भकः ।। ७.६.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: rādheyo bahumāyī ca lokapālo 'tha dhārmikaḥ ।yamalārjunau ca hārdikyaḥ śumbhaścaiva niśumbhakaḥ ।। 7.6.35 ॥

translations.english: The death of Hiranyakashipu and other enemies of the gods, such as Namuchi, Kalanemi, and Samhrada, the best of heroes, was also caused by him.
translations.hindi: वैसे ही विहार करने लगे, जैसे देवता अप्सराओं के साथ बिहार किआ करते हैं । कुछ दिनों बाद माल्यवान ने अपनी. सौन्दर्यंवती सुन्दरी नामक पत्नो से

verses.sloka: असुरा दानवाश्चैव सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः ।सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते ऽपराजिताः ।। ७.६.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: asurā dānavāścaiva sattvavanto mahābalāḥ ।sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante 'parājitāḥ ।। 7.6.36 ॥

translations.english: This verse lists several powerful and deceitful Asuras, including Radheya, Bahumayi, Lokapala, Dharmika, Yamala and Arjuna, Hardikya, Shumbha, and Nishumbhaka.

verses.sloka: सर्वैः क्रतुशतैरिष्टं सर्वे मायाविदस्तथा ।सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः सर्वे शत्रुभयङ्कराः ।। ७.६.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvaiḥ kratuśatairiṣṭaṁ sarve māyāvidastathā ।sarve sarvāstrakuśalāḥ sarve śatrubhayaṅkarāḥ ।। 7.6.37 ॥

translations.english: All these Asuras and Danavas, though endowed with great strength and power, are never heard to have remained undefeated once they entered battle.

verses.sloka: नारायणेन निहताः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ।एतज्ज्ञात्वा तु सर्वेषां क्षमं कर्तुमिहार्हथ ।। ७.६.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇena nihatāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ।etajjñātvā tu sarveṣāṁ kṣamaṁ kartumihārhatha ।। 7.6.38 ॥

translations.english: All of them had performed hundreds of sacrifices, were skilled in various illusions, proficient in all weapons, and struck terror into their enemies.
translations.hindi: सुमाली की भायां भो पूर्णिमा के चन्द्रमा की तरह सुन्दर | ` मुखवाली थी। हे राम ! उसका नाम केतुमती था ऑर वहः अपने पति को प्राणों से भी बढ़ कर प्यारी थी

verses.sloka: ततः सुमाली माली च श्रुत्वा माल्यवतो वचः ।ऊचतुर्भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं भगांशाविव वासवम् ।। ७.६.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sumālī mālī ca śrutvā mālyavato vacaḥ ।ūcaturbhrātaraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ bhagāṁśāviva vāsavam ।। 7.6.39 ॥

translations.english: Knowing that these very beings were slain by Narayana in hundreds and thousands, you should now grant forgiveness to all of them here.

verses.sloka: स्वधीतं दत्तमिष्टं चाप्यैश्वर्यं परिपालितम् ।आयुर्निरामयं प्राप्तं सुधर्मः प्रापितः पथि ।। ७.६.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: svadhītaṁ dattamiṣṭaṁ cāpyaiśvaryaṁ paripālitam ।āyurnirāmayaṁ prāptaṁ sudharmaḥ prāpitaḥ pathi ।। 7.6.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, Sumali and Mali, having heard the words of Malyavan, spoke to their elder brother, just as Bhaga and Amsha would speak to Indra.

verses.sloka: देवसागरमक्षोभ्यं शस्त्रैः समवगाह्य च ।जिता द्विषो ह्यप्रतिमास्तन्नो मृत्युकृतं भयम् ।। ७.६.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: devasāgaramakṣobhyaṁ śastraiḥ samavagāhya ca ।jitā dviṣo hyapratimāstanno mṛtyukṛtaṁ bhayam ।। 7.6.41 ॥

translations.english: We have diligently studied, given charity, performed sacrifices, maintained our sovereignty, attained a healthy life, and established righteousness on our path.
translations.hindi: संहादि, प्रघस, ओर भासकर्ण--ये तो महाबली सुमाली के पुत्र हुए और कुम्भीनसी, कैकसी, राका और पुष्पोत्कटा नाम की कन्याए भी सुमाली ने उत्पन्न कीं

verses.sloka: नारायणश्च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्चापि यमस्तथा ।अस्माकं प्रमुखे स्थातुं सर्वे बिभ्यति सर्वदा ।। ७.६.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaśca rudraśca śakraścāpi yamastathā ।asmākaṁ pramukhe sthātuṁ sarve bibhyati sarvadā ।। 7.6.42 ॥

translations.english: Having plunged into the unagitable ocean of gods with our weapons, and having conquered unequalled enemies, we therefore have no fear caused by death.
translations.hindi: हे स्वासिन्‌ ! अत्यन्त रूपवती वसुधा नाम को गन्धर्वी माली रावस की भाया थी । उसके नेत्र कमल की तरह होने के कारण एक श्रेष्ठ यदी के समान थे

verses.sloka: विष्णोर्देवस्य नास्त्येव कारणं राक्षसेश्वर ।देवानामेव दोषेण विष्णोः प्रचलितं मनः ।। ७.६.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇordevasya nāstyeva kāraṇaṁ rākṣaseśvara ।devānāmeva doṣeṇa viṣṇoḥ pracalitaṁ manaḥ ।। 7.6.43 ॥

translations.english: Narayana, Rudra, Shakra, and Yama, all of them always fear to stand in our presence.
translations.hindi: हे प्रभो ! सुमाली के छोटे भाई माली ने उस खी के गर्भ से जो जो स-तान उत्पन्न किए, में अब उनको बतलातां हूँ । सुनें

verses.sloka: तस्मादद्य समुद्युक्ताः सर्वसैन्यसमावृताः ।देवानेव जिघांसाम एभ्यो दोषः समुत्थितः ।। ७.६.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādadya samudyuktāḥ sarvasainyasamāvṛtāḥ ।devāneva jighāṁsāma ebhyo doṣaḥ samutthitaḥ ।। 7.6.44 ॥

translations.english: O lord of Rakshasas, there is indeed no inherent reason for the god Vishnu to act against us; it is only due to the fault of the other gods that Vishnu's mind has been agitated.
translations.hindi: अनल, अनिल, हर और सम्पाति ये माली के पुत्र थे और ये ही चारों विभोषण के मंत्रो हुए

verses.sloka: एवं सम्मन्त्र्य बलिनः सर्वे सैन्यसमावृताः ।उद्योगं घोषयित्वा तु सर्वे नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवाः ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ sammantrya balinaḥ sarve sainyasamāvṛtāḥ ।udyogaṁ ghoṣayitvā tu sarve nairṛtapuṅgavāḥ ॥

translations.english: Therefore, today, fully prepared and surrounded by all our armies, we shall kill the gods, for the fault has originated from them.
translations.hindi: राक्षसो में श्रेष्ठ उन तीन रात्तसों का परिवार बहुत बढ़ गया । वे तीनों राक्षस अपने सैकडौं पुत्रों के साथ इन्द्र सहित समस्त देवताओं, ऋषियों, नागों और यक्षों को सताने लगे

verses.sloka: युद्धाय निर्ययुः क्रुद्धा जम्भवृत्रबला इव ।। ७.६.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yuddhāya niryayuḥ kruddhā jambhavṛtrabalā iva ।। 7.6.45 ॥

translations.english: Having thus deliberated, all the powerful and foremost Rākṣasas, surrounded by their armies, announced their preparations and set out for battle, enraged like the demons Jambha, Vṛtra, and Bala.
translations.hindi: इति पञ्चमः सगः ॥ वे सब दुरासद रातस, वायु की तरह संसार में सबेत्र भ्रमण करते थे । ये समस्त राइस संग्रामक्षेत्र में काल के समान अमित तेजस्वी हो जाते थे और बरदान पाने से अत्यन्त गार्वित हो सदैव यज्ञों को नष्ट किआ करते थे

verses.sloka: इति ते राम सम्मन्त्र्य सर्वोद्योगेन राक्षसाः ।युद्धाय निर्ययुः सर्वे महाकाया महाबलाः ।। ७.६.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: iti te rāma sammantrya sarvodyogena rākṣasāḥ ।yuddhāya niryayuḥ sarve mahākāyā mahābalāḥ ।। 7.6.46 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having thus deliberated with full preparation, all those Rākṣasas of huge bodies and great strength set out for battle.

verses.sloka: स्यन्दनैर्वारणैश्चैव हयैश्च गिरिसन्निभैः ।खरैर्गोभी रथोष्ट्रैश्च शिंशुमारैर्भुजङ्गमैः ।। ७.६.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: syandanairvāraṇaiścaiva hayaiśca girisannibhaiḥ ।kharairgobhī rathoṣṭraiśca śiṁśumārairbhujaṅgamaiḥ ।। 7.6.47 ॥

translations.english: They set out with chariots, elephants, mountain-like horses, donkeys, cows, camel-drawn chariots, porpoises, and serpents.

verses.sloka: मकरैः कच्छपैर्मीनैर्विहङ्गैर्गरुडोपमैः ।सिंहैर्व्याघ्रैर्वराहैश्च सृमरैश्चमरैरपि ।। ७.६.४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: makaraiḥ kacchapairmīnairvihaṅgairgaruḍopamaiḥ ।siṁhairvyāghrairvarāhaiśca sṛmaraiścamarairapi ।। 7.6.48 ॥

translations.english: They also advanced with crocodiles, tortoises, fish, birds resembling Garuḍa, lions, tigers, boars, antelopes, and yaks.

verses.sloka: त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां गताः सर्वे राक्षसा बलगर्विताः ।प्रयाता देवलोकाय योद्धुं दैवतशत्रवः ।। ७.६.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā laṅkāṁ gatāḥ sarve rākṣasā balagarvitāḥ ।prayātā devalokāya yoddhuṁ daivataśatravaḥ ।। 7.6.49 ॥

translations.english: All the Rākṣasas, proud of their strength and enemies of the gods, abandoned Lanka and set out for the world of the gods to fight.

verses.sloka: लङ्काविपर्ययं दृष्ट्वा यानि लङ्कालयान्यथ ।भूतानि भयदर्शीनि विमनस्कानि सर्वशः ।। ७.६.५० ॥
verses.transliteration: laṅkāviparyayaṁ dṛṣṭvā yāni laṅkālayānyatha ।bhūtāni bhayadarśīni vimanaskāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 7.6.50 ॥

translations.english: Seeing the impending destruction of Lanka, all the beings dwelling there became utterly fearful and disheartened.

verses.sloka: रथोत्तमैरुह्यमानाः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ।। ७.६.५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: rathottamairuhyamānāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ।। 7.6.51 ॥

translations.english: Hundreds and thousands of them were being carried by excellent chariots.

verses.sloka: प्रयाता राक्षसास्तूर्णं देवलोकं प्रयत्नतः ।रक्षसामेव मार्गेण दैवतान्यपचक्रमुः ।। ७.६.५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: prayātā rākṣasāstūrṇaṁ devalokaṁ prayatnataḥ ।rakṣasāmeva mārgeṇa daivatānyapacakramuḥ ।। 7.6.52 ॥

translations.english: The Rakshasas quickly departed to the world of gods with great effort, and even the deities departed by the very path used by the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: भौमाश्चैवान्तरिक्षाश्च कालाज्ञप्ता भयावहाः ।उत्पाता राक्षसेन्द्राणामभावाय समुत्थिताः ।। ७.६.५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhaumāścaivāntarikṣāśca kālājñaptā bhayāvahāḥ ।utpātā rākṣasendrāṇāmabhāvāya samutthitāḥ ।। 7.6.53 ॥

translations.english: Terrifying earthly and atmospheric portents, commanded by fate, arose for the destruction of the chief Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: अस्थीनि मेघा ववृषुरुष्णं शोणितमेव च ।वेलां समुद्राश्चोत्क्रान्ताश्चेलुश्चाप्यथ भूधराः ।। ७.६.५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: asthīni meghā vavṛṣuruṣṇaṁ śoṇitameva ca ।velāṁ samudrāścotkrāntāśceluścāpyatha bhūdharāḥ ।। 7.6.54 ॥

translations.english: Clouds rained bones and hot blood, oceans overflowed their shores, and mountains also trembled.

verses.sloka: अट्टहासान्विमुञ्चन्तो घननादसमस्वनाः ।वाश्यन्त्यश्च शिवास्तत्र दारुणं घोरदर्शनाः ।। ७.६.५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṭṭahāsānvimuñcanto ghananādasamasvanāḥ ।vāśyantyaśca śivāstatra dāruṇaṁ ghoradarśanāḥ ।। 7.6.55 ॥

translations.english: There, jackals, frightful to behold and making terrible, thunder-like sounds and loud roars, were howling.

verses.sloka: सम्पतन्त्यथ भूतानि दृश्यन्ते च यथाक्रमम् ।गृध्रचक्रं महच्चात्र ज्वलनोद्गारिभिर्मुखैः ।। ७.६.५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sampatantyatha bhūtāni dṛśyante ca yathākramam ।gṛdhracakraṁ mahaccātra jvalanodgāribhirmukhaiḥ ।। 7.6.56 ॥

translations.english: Then, ominous spirits were seen appearing successively, and a large flock of vultures with flame-emitting mouths was also present.

verses.sloka: राक्षसानामुपरि खे भ्रमते ऽलातचक्रवत् ।कपोता रक्तपादाश्च शारिका विद्रुता ययुः ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāmupari khe bhramate 'lātacakravat ।kapotā raktapādāśca śārikā vidrutā yayuḥ ॥

translations.english: Above the Rakshasas, the vultures hovered in the sky like a fiery wheel, while red-footed pigeons and mynah birds fled, and two-footed cats and crows cawed right there.

verses.sloka: काका वाश्यन्ति तत्रैव बिडाला वै द्विपादयः ।। ७.६.५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: kākā vāśyanti tatraiva biḍālā vai dvipādayaḥ ।। 7.6.57 ॥

translations.english: Disregarding those omens, the Rakshasas, proud of their strength and bound by the noose of death, continued to advance and did not turn back.

verses.sloka: उत्पातांस्ताननादृत्य राक्षसा बलगर्विताः ।यान्त्येव न निवर्त्तन्ते मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः ।। ७.६.५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: utpātāṁstānanādṛtya rākṣasā balagarvitāḥ ।yāntyeva na nivarttante mṛtyupāśāvapāśitāḥ ।। 7.6.58 ॥

translations.english: Malyavan, Sumali, and Mali, all exceedingly mighty, were the leaders of those Rakshasas, just as fires are foremost in sacrifices.

verses.sloka: माल्यवांश्च सुमाली च माली च सुमहाबलाः ।आसन्पुरःसरास्तेषां क्रतूनामिव पावकाः ।। ७.६.५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: mālyavāṁśca sumālī ca mālī ca sumahābalāḥ ।āsanpuraḥsarāsteṣāṁ kratūnāmiva pāvakāḥ ।। 7.6.59 ॥

translations.english: All those night-wandering demons indeed took refuge in Malyavan, just as gods resort to Brahma, and as one would take refuge in an unmoving mountain.

verses.sloka: माल्यवन्तं च ते सर्वे माल्यवन्तमिवाचलम् ।निशाचरा ह्याश्रयन्ति धातारमिव देवताः ।। ७.६.६० ॥
verses.transliteration: mālyavantaṁ ca te sarve mālyavantamivācalam ।niśācarā hyāśrayanti dhātāramiva devatāḥ ।। 7.6.60 ॥

translations.english: That army of the demon lords, resounding like the crashing of great clouds, went to the world of gods, which was under Mali's sway, with a desire for victory.

verses.sloka: तद्बलं राक्षसेन्द्राणां महाभ्रघननादितम् ।जयेप्सया देवलोकं ययौ मालिवशे स्थितम् ।। ७.६.६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadbalaṁ rākṣasendrāṇāṁ mahābhraghananāditam ।jayepsayā devalokaṁ yayau mālivaśe sthitam ।। 7.6.61 ॥

translations.english: But the Lord Nārāyaṇa, having heard of that preparation by the Rākṣasas from a messenger of the gods, then set his mind on battle.

verses.sloka: राक्षसानां समुद्योगं तं तु नारायणः प्रभुः ।देवदूतादुपश्रुत्य चक्रे युद्धे तदा मनः ।। ७.६.६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ samudyogaṁ taṁ tu nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।devadūtādupaśrutya cakre yuddhe tadā manaḥ ।। 7.6.62 ॥

translations.english: He, with weapons and quivers ready, stood upon Vainateya (Garuda), having donned his divine armor that shone with the brilliance of a thousand suns.

verses.sloka: स सज्जायुधतूणीरो वैनतेयोपरि स्थितः ।आसज्ज्य कवचं दिव्यं सहस्रार्कसमद्युति ।। ७.६.६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa sajjāyudhatūṇīro vainateyopari sthitaḥ ।āsajjya kavacaṁ divyaṁ sahasrārkasamadyuti ।। 7.6.63 ॥

translations.english: Then, the lotus-eyed Nārāyaṇa fastened his two pure quivers full of arrows, his pure waist-band, and his sword, along with his excellent weapons: the conch, discus, mace, Śārṅga bow, and sword.

verses.sloka: आबध्य शरसम्पूर्णे इषुधी विमले तदा ।श्रोणिसूत्रं च खड्गं च विमलं कमलेक्षणः ॥
verses.transliteration: ābadhya śarasampūrṇe iṣudhī vimale tadā ।śroṇisūtraṁ ca khaḍgaṁ ca vimalaṁ kamalekṣaṇaḥ ॥

translations.english: The Lord, having mounted the mountain-like Garuda, the son of Vinata, swiftly departed for the destruction of the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गखड्गाख्यप्रवरायुधान् ।। ७.६.६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgakhaḍgākhyapravarāyudhān ।। 7.6.64 ॥

translations.english: Dark-complexioned Hari, adorned in yellow garments, shone on Garuda's back like a lightning-streaked cloud upon the peak of a golden mountain.

verses.sloka: सुपर्णं गिरिसङ्काशं वैनतेयमथास्थितः ।राक्षसानामभावाय ययौ तूर्णतरं प्रभुः ।। ७.६.६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: suparṇaṁ girisaṅkāśaṁ vainateyamathāsthitaḥ ।rākṣasānāmabhāvāya yayau tūrṇataraṁ prabhuḥ ।। 7.6.65 ॥

translations.english: Praised by Siddhas, Devas, Rishis, great serpents, Gandharvas, and Yakshas, he, holding the discus, sword, Sharnga bow, and conch, approached the enemies of the Asura army.
translations.hindi: वा० रा० ३०-4 हे मह्राज ! सुमाली ने अपनी भार्या केतुमती के गर्भ से जो सन्ताने उत्पन्न की, अब मैं उनके नाम आपको क्रम से सुनाता हूँ

verses.sloka: सुपर्णपृष्ठे स बभौ श्यामः पीताम्बरो हरिः ।काञ्चनस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे सतडित्तोयदो यथा ।। ७.६.६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: suparṇapṛṣṭhe sa babhau śyāmaḥ pītāmbaro hariḥ ।kāñcanasya gireḥ śṛṅge sataḍittoyado yathā ।। 7.6.66 ॥

translations.english: That army of the Rakshasa king, with its banners scattered by the wind from Garuda's wings, fluttering flags, and scattered weapons, trembled like a blue mountain king with dislodged rocks.

verses.sloka: स सिद्धदेवर्षिमहोरगैश्च गन्धर्वयक्षैरुपगीयमानः ।समाससादासुरसैन्यशत्रूंश्चक्रासिशार्ङ्गायुधशङ्खपाणिः ।। ७.६.६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa siddhadevarṣimahoragaiśca gandharvayakṣairupagīyamānaḥ ।samāsasādāsurasainyaśatrūṁścakrāsiśārṅgāyudhaśaṅkhapāṇiḥ ।। 7.6.67 ॥

translations.english: Then, the night-wandering Rakshasas, surrounding Madhava, pierced him by thousands with their excellent weapons, which were smeared with blood and flesh and resembled the destructive fire at the end of an eon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षष्ठः सर्गः ।। 6 ।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: सुपर्णपक्षानिलनुन्नपक्षं भ्रमत्पताकं प्रविकीर्णशस्त्रम् ।चचाल तद्राक्षसराजसैन्यं चलोपलं नील इवाचलेन्द्रः ।। ७.६.६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: suparṇapakṣānilanunnapakṣaṁ bhramatpatākaṁ pravikīrṇaśastram ।cacāla tadrākṣasarājasainyaṁ calopalaṁ nīla ivācalendraḥ ।। 7.6.68 ॥

translations.english: Thus ends the sixth canto of the Uttara Kanda in the Ramayana, the first poem, composed by the sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: ततः शरैः शोणितमांसरूषितैर्युगान्तवैश्वानरतुल्यविग्रहैः ।निशाचराः सम्परिवार्य माधवं वरायुधैर्निर्बिभिदुः सहस्रशः ।। ७.६.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaraiḥ śoṇitamāṁsarūṣitairyugāntavaiśvānaratulyavigrahaiḥ ।niśācarāḥ samparivārya mādhavaṁ varāyudhairnirbibhiduḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 7.6.69 ।।
